guarantees.claim: When reset (rst_ni=0), sw_cmd_o is loaded with CmdNone on every clock edge.
When not in reset and block_swcmd is deasserted, sw_cmd_o follows sw_cmd_i on the clock edge.
When not in reset and block_swcmd is asserted, sw_cmd_o retains its previous value because no assignment occurs.

assumptions.claim: block_swcmd is asserted by external logic to prevent sw_cmd_o from updating only when the downstream consumer is not ready to accept a new command.
assumptions.risk: If block_swcmd is asserted while the downstream is ready, sw_cmd_o holds a stale command, potentially causing repeated or missed operations.

uncertain_points.claim: The purpose and timing contract of block_swcmd are not defined in this chunk, making it unclear whether there is a risk of sw_cmd_o capturing a partial or transient sw_cmd_i when block_swcmd deasserts near a sw_cmd_i change.
uncertain_points.risk: If sw_cmd_i changes while block_swcmd is deasserted, sw_cmd_o might capture an unstable value, potentially propagating an invalid command.
